messages: The Arcforging master, #p602# of #m10005000#, seems to be searching for someone who could become his apprentice.

The Arcforging master, #p602# of #m10005000#, gave me a test after I asked to become his apprentice. He said true Arcforgers must possess great wisdom and instructed me to defeat monsters around #m10005000# and collect #b1 #t4020000##k.
I passed the test given by the Arcforging master, #p602# of #m10005000#. Does this mean I can finally stand as a true Arcforger of Maple World?
name: Chrishrama in Need of an Apprentice
